title: Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5)
function: Class 150/300 blind flange for chemical piping
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Class 150/300 blind flange for chemical piping requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by class 150/300 blind flange for chemical piping and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance at 200W fiber laser
TIG welding Grade 2 at 200W fiber laser
Hydrostatic shell test at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for class 150300 blind application
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for class 150300 blind performance

faq.q: What facing standards are available for Blind flange / ASME flange flanged connections?
faq.a: Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) flanged connections can be supplied with raised face (RF), flat face (FF), ring-type joint (RTJ), or male-female (M/F) facings per ASME B16.5. Surface finish 125-250 µin Ra for RF facings. For class 150300 blind, RTJ or M/F facings are recommended to eliminate potential leak paths in toxic or flammable chemical service.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Blind Flange (ASME B16.5) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for class 150300 blind.
